'''Kesha Weebe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who ran the ''[[Farmer's Folly]]'' in [[Starpoint (city)|Starpoint]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. A widow, she had run the establishment for a quarter of a century by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
